BSC15-006.name: Heavy-Tankmobile T-35
BSC15-006.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is Destroyed by the Opponent]
Summon this Spirit card.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can block while exhausted. When you control any Ultimate, also, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.

BSC15-011.name: Frigate-Golem
BSC15-011.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
If you control any Blue Ultimates, summon this Spirit card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Treat the Braves on all opposing Brave Spirits as Cost 0, and destroy an opposing Cost 8 or less Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Turn)
All your "Artificial Soldier" family Spirits/Ultimates get +2000 BP.

BSC15-003.name: Satoridemon
BSC15-003.effect:
After your Burst activates, return this Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Send cores from every opposing Spirit to the Reserve until only one core remains on each of them. After this effect resolves, if you control any Ultimate, summon this Spirit card.
